config.second_extractor: pdfplumber, text-based column detection (booktabs tables have no vertical rules, so the default line-based detector returns nothing)
config.match_rule: identical (mean, dispersion) pair anywhere in the document
config.sample: 10 random NeurIPS/ICML 2025 papers, seed 5, 3 of which report dispersion

notes: 78.2 percent of values with an error bar are independently confirmed. Inspection of the disagreements shows most are failures of the second extractor -- it reads 0.542 as 542.0, the same digit-splitting bug the primary extractor had before it was fixed -- so this rate is a lower bound on primary accuracy, not a central estimate. Needs a larger sample and a hand-adjudicated subset of the disagreements.
